_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: I lift up my eyes to the hills; from where will my help come?
We will not let you go until you bless us.
Jacob wrestled until the breaking of the day.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
Our help comes from the Lord, who keeps our going out and coming in.
Come, let us worship. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: All night by the river a man wrestles a stranger and will not quit, even limping, even spent.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
Pray like that, Jesus says — like the widow who wore down the judge — and do not lose heart.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
The Lord neither slumbers nor sleeps; he keeps watch over your life.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
So we come to worship holding on, lifting our eyes to the hills, asking and not giving up.
We will not let you go until you bless us!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: All night Jacob wrestles and will not quit.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
Pray like the widow; do not lose heart.
We will not let you go until you bless us.
Our help comes from the Lord, who never sleeps.
We will not let you go until you bless us. Amen.
